notes: Checked 2026-10-26 on AsiaTVDrama embeds (bysefujedu.com/e/CODE, filemoon.sx/e/CODE and filemoon.to/e/CODE: one backend, “Byse Frontend”). The embed page is an empty app shell; its player asks the API /api/videos/CODE, which answers the stream list encrypted (AES-256-GCM, the key in parts chosen by a version number). Sahra's built-in “byse” decode undoes it and reads sources[].url, an HLS playlist signed for the device that asked (about 15 minutes), so it is read at Play time only. API, nothing scraped from HTML.
